Eve (PM): Heads-up  two pilots asked to include bulk embeddings in MVP. Infra flagged a capacity dip next week. Need scope call.
Liam (Eng): What are pilot SLOs?
Noor (CS): Interactive p50 <= 220ms; nightly bulk ~8M tokens. They can pay for reserved capacity if we guarantee it.
Sam (Infra): We're losing ~25% Dedicated GPUs for maintenance. Autoscale helps short bursts but sustained jobs will queue.
Eve (PM): Options: A) full include + reserve slots for pilots B) public MVP ships without bulk, pilots opt-in to reserved carve C) delay bulk to v1.
Liam (Eng): B seems safest: keeps public timeline, gives pilots what they need behind a gate. Implementation: org flag + routing to reserved pool + fallback model.
Alex (Design): If B, hide bulk-upload UI for public and add "Pilot: bulk uploads enabled" in org settings.
Noor (CS): I'll ask pilots for LOIs and push for signed MOUs. Verbal OK for now.
Sam (Infra): For a carve we can schedule 02:00-06:00 UTC nightly with 2 GPUs reserved. Need ~48h to provision and test. We'll add dashboard panels and alerts.
Liam (Eng): Work plan: flag (1d), routing + tests (2d), canary (0.5d). Add fallback to quantized model at queue>70%. Smoke tests for nightly sim.
Eve (PM): Acceptance for pilot carve: up to 8M tokens/night, interactive p50<=220ms, alerts at queue>50%, signed MOU for billing. Timeline: aim to land pilot gate in 3 days.
Noor (CS): I'll aim for LOIs today; if not signed by EOD+2, we auto-disable pilot bulk and notify customers.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feat/pilot-bulk-gate -> staging at 2367890150
Liam (Eng): Noted. I'll post PR + canary metrics in this thread.
Sam (Infra): I'll provision and share dashboards; will alert if capacity changes.
Eve (PM): Decision: go with B (hybrid/gated pilot). Action owners: Liam (flag+routing), Sam (provision+dash), Alex (UI), Noor (contracts). Reopen if legal or infra blocks appear. :thumbsup:
